title: Client Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Post :- Client Relationship Manager**

**Experience Required: 3+ years in a Team Lead / Senior Account Management role**

**Shift Timings: 7.30pm to 4.30am - Monday to Friday**

**Alternate Saturdays would be 3pm to 12am (working 1st 3rd 5th)**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Client Relationship Manager to oversee a team of 5-6 Virtual Assistants (VAs) and provide administrative and operational support. The ideal candidate will act as the primary liaison between the client(s) and the VA team, ensuring smooth project execution, clear communication, and high-quality deliverables.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Team Management:

* Supervise and lead a team of 5-6 Virtual Assistants, ensuring they meet deadlines and deliver exceptional work.
* Assign tasks and monitor the team's workload to optimize efficiency.
* Provide guidance, training, and performance feedback to the team.
* Resolve any conflicts or issues within the team promptly and professionally.

Client Account Management:

* Act as the main point of contact for clients, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
* Manage client relationships by maintaining regular communication and providing updates on project progress.
* Anticipate client needs and proactively propose solutions or improvements.

Administrative Support:

* Oversee day-to-day administrative tasks such as calendar management, email correspondence, and data entry.
* Ensure that all processes and workflows are documented, efficient, and followed by the team.
* Handle invoicing, budget tracking, and reporting as required.

Operational Coordination:

* Track project timelines and milestones, ensuring the team adheres to deadlines.
* Collaborate with clients and team members to clarify goals and expectations.
* Troubleshoot operational challenges and implement strategies for improvement.

Quality Assurance:

* Review team outputs for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to client requirements.
* Implement quality control processes and ensure team alignment with organizational standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

* Proven experience in administrative support or account management roles (3+ years preferred). Experience managing and leading remote teams.
* Proficient in tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office or other project management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
* Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to challenges

title: Customer Support Associate
description:
**ABOUT ASITE**

Asite is the digital construction platform trusted by the organisations that build at scale. Our vision is simple: connect people everywhere and help the world build better – faster, smarter, with fewer failures and less rework. We connect the physical, digital, and human dimensions of construction, making project information actionable, auditable, and secure at every stage of the asset lifecycle – from feasibility and design through construction, handover, and operations.

From 3D modelling and secure agentic AI to document control and field collaboration, Asite works across every discipline and every tier of the supply chain. We help clients meet the standards that matter, including Golden Thread reporting under the Building Safety Act and ISO 19650 – so the right information is always traceable and available to the people who need it.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As a Customer Support Supervisor at Asite, you will lead and support the Customer Support team by overseeing daily operations, monitoring SLAs and KPIs, managing escalations, coaching team members, allocating workloads, driving process improvements, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and service quality.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide customer support via email, chat, and phone.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application issues.
* Log, prioritize, and manage support tickets within SLA.
* Escalate complex issues to the appropriate teams.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation.
* Guide customers on product features and best practices.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
* Ensure high customer satisfaction (CSAT/CX).
* Contribute to knowledge base articles and process improvements.
* Stay updated on product enhancements and new releases.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree (preferred)
* 1–3 years of customer support or technical support experience (preferred).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Basic understanding of SaaS applications and cloud technologies.
* Experience with ticketing/support tools (e.g., Intercom, Zendesk, Jira, Freshdesk).
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts, including weekends or holidays if required.

**Must have**

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with CRM or helpdesk platforms (e.g., Intercom).
* Knowledge of ITIL or customer support best practices.
* Basic understanding of APIs, SSO, or web technologies.
* Experience supporting enterprise or B2B SaaS customers.
* Familiarity with SQL, log analysis, or browser developer tools.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Knowledge of Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience creating or maintaining knowledge base articles.

title: Support Team Lead
description:

The role requires strong team management skills, hands-on experience with Zoho, and the ability to monitor customer queries, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution across support channels.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Role Purpose

MachineAstro is looking for a commercially driven Key Account Manager responsible for growing strategic industrial accounts through customer value creation, new opportunity hunting, use-case development, account expansion and revenue growth. The role combines consultative selling with strong technical understanding of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring and asset health. The KAM will work across plant, corporate, technical, procurement and senior-management stakeholders and convert customer problems into measurable business outcomes and sustainable revenue.

 Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Key Account Ownership

·      Own assigned strategic accounts and prepare account plans covering customer priorities, installed base, stakeholders, whitespace, opportunities, risks and growth actions.

·      Build multi-level relationships across maintenance, reliability, engineering, operations, digital/IT, procurement and senior management.

·      Understand customer operations, asset criticality, maintenance practices and business priorities to identify areas where MachineAstro can create value.

2. Account Growth & Expansion

·      Drive year-on-year growth within existing accounts through cross-sell, upsell, additional assets, plants, business units, applications and services.

·      Identify whitespace and increase MachineAstro share of wallet by expanding successful deployments from machine/area level to line, plant, multi-site or enterprise programs.

·      Convert successful POCs, pilots and initial deployments into repeat and larger commercial programs.

3. Opportunity & Use-Case Hunting

·      Proactively identify new customer problems, reliability gaps and business cases rather than relying only on inbound enquiries or RFQs.

·      Identify opportunities related to recurring failures, unplanned downtime, maintenance cost, inspection effort, safety, critical rotating equipment and predictive-maintenance initiatives.

·      Develop new use cases and convert identified pain points into qualified opportunities with clear technical, commercial and value propositions.

·      Maintain strong focus on pipeline creation, opportunity quality and conversion.

4. Value Creation & Consultative Selling

·      Position MachineAstro as a reliability and technology partner, linking solutions to measurable customer outcomes.

·      Develop ROI/value cases around downtime avoidance, maintenance cost reduction, asset availability, reliability, safety and productivity.

·      Work with SMEs and presales to quantify value, develop solution proposals and demonstrate business impact.

·      Capture successful outcomes and replicate proven value propositions across similar accounts or plants.

5. Customer Engagement, POC & Solution Execution

·      Conduct regular customer plant visits, asset assessments, POC discussions, technical workshops, demonstrations, reviews and training.

·      Lead customer-facing POCs with clear objectives, success criteria, timelines and commercial conversion plans.

·      Coordinate project planning and delivery from the account perspective, ensuring commitments and customer expectations are met.

·      Identify expansion opportunities during and immediately after implementation.

6. Technical & Fault-Analysis Coordination

·      Understand vibration and condition-monitoring concepts and customer asset failure modes sufficiently to lead technical-commercial discussions.

·      Coordinate with CAT-II/CAT-III analysts and SMEs for asset fault analysis, recommendations and data-driven customer insights.

·      Translate technical findings into operational impact, business value and recommended next actions.

7. Customer Success & Retention

·      Ensure customers realize measurable value from deployed solutions and maintain high levels of adoption and satisfaction.

·      Identify risks to customer satisfaction, renewal, adoption or expansion and drive timely resolution with internal teams.

·      Convert customer success into references, case studies, repeat deployments and expansion opportunities.

8. Internal & Partner Collaboration

·      Align SMEs, presales, product management, inside sales, delivery and customer-success teams around account priorities and opportunity strategy.

·      Develop productive relationships with system integrators, consultants and technology partners to create and expand opportunities.

·      Share customer requirements, market feedback and competitive intelligence with relevant internal teams.

9. Commercial Management & Payment Follow-up

·      Own commercial follow-up for assigned accounts in coordination with finance, sales operations and business teams.

·      Track purchase orders, invoicing, payment milestones, outstanding receivables and agreed credit terms.

·      Proactively follow up with customer commercial/procurement/accounts-payable teams to ensure invoices are processed and payments are received on time.

·      Escalate overdue payments, disputes and commercial risks promptly and coordinate resolution with internal stakeholders.

·      Maintain healthy receivables and ensure account growth is supported by disciplined cash collection.

10. Market Intelligence & Marketing Support

·      Track industry trends, customer priorities, competitor positioning and emerging technologies in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance and Industrial IoT.

·      Identify market intelligence that can improve MachineAstro's value proposition and opportunity strategy.

·      Support marketing with customer insights, case studies, application stories, demos, blogs, videos and success stories.

11. Revenue & Management Reporting

·      Own account-level revenue growth in collaboration with Business Development and Sales leadership.

·      Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, opportunity stages, closure plans and account-growth metrics.

·      Provide management updates on revenue, pipeline, new use cases, expansion opportunities, customer risks, collections and strategic actions.

   Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·      Year-on-year revenue growth from assigned key accounts

·      New revenue generated from existing customers

·      Account expansion and share-of-wallet growth

·      New opportunities and qualified pipeline generated

·      New use cases / business cases developed

·      POC-to-commercial conversion rate

·      New plants, business units and assets penetrated

·      Customer retention, satisfaction and referenceability

·      Forecast accuracy and opportunity conversion

·      On-time collection / receivables performance and reduction of overdue payments

·      Strategic account-plan execution and stakeholder coverage

 Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hunter-farmer and trusted advisor who can protect and grow existing relationships while continuously discovering new customer problems, creating business value and converting opportunities into revenue. The candidate should be comfortable engaging with plant engineers as well as senior business leaders and should combine technical credibility with strong commercial ownership.

 Qualifications & Experience

·      BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering – preferred/required based on role fit

·      10+ years of relevant experience in industrial B2B sales, key account management, business development, reliability, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, industrial automation or related fields

·      CAT-II / CAT-III Vibration Certification – strongly preferred

·      MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or related discipline – preferred

·      Demonstrated experience managing strategic industrial accounts and delivering account growth

·      Experience with manufacturing/process industries and technical solution selling is highly desirable

 Core Competencies

·      Strategic Key Account Management

·      Account Expansion, Cross-sell & Upsell

·      Opportunity Hunting & Consultative Selling

·      Value Selling and Business Case Development

·      Vibration / Condition Monitoring Understanding

·      Customer & Executive Stakeholder Management

·      Commercial Negotiation and Collection Follow-up

·      Pipeline, Forecasting and Revenue Ownership

·      Problem Solving and Cross-functional Leadership

·      Strong communication, presentation and plant-level engagement skills

 Preferred Industry Exposure

Automotive & Auto Components • Steel & Metals • Cement • Power & Energy • Oil & Gas • Petrochemical • Chemicals • Pharmaceuticals • FMCG • Food Processing • Pulp & Paper • Mining • General Manufacturing • Process Industries • Industrial Automation / IIoT • Condition Monitoring / Predictive Maintenance

  Role Success Statement

* The core objective of the role is to grow strategic accounts by creating more value for customers. Success means deeper stakeholder relationships, more use cases, larger deployments, new plants and business units, stronger customer outcomes, healthy collections and sustainable year-on-year revenue growth.

operations.

businessTurn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.Keep the first client a We are looking for an owner who can scale affiliate, cashback, coupon and fintech/super-app partnerships into a core revenue channel. The goal is low-CAC incremental sales and new-customer acquisition across our D2C website and marketplace.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Affiliate Programs
* Build and scale the in-house D2C affiliate program on Shopify Plus, covering partner onboarding, tracking links, payouts and fraud control.
* Manage third-party affiliate networks and portals (Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission, Impact, etc.) and continuously add new publishers.
* Onboard influencers, creators, content/review sites and deal communities as affiliate partners.
* Cashback & Coupon Ecosystem
* Build partnerships and run campaigns with cashback portals (CashKaro, GoPaisa, etc.) and coupon portals (GrabOn, CouponDunia, etc.).
* Own the brand-wise coupon strategy: code structure, discount depth, exclusivity, leakage control, and monitoring of coupon abuse and brand-bidding.
* Super-App & Rewards Partnerships
* Launch offers, coupons, rewards and co-branded campaigns on platforms such as PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay and Zomato.
* Explore new platforms and bank, fintech and loyalty partnerships that bring in high-intent customers.
* Planning & Campaigns
* Create a partner-wise campaign calendar for launches, festive sales (Diwali, BFCM, EOSS) and key SKUs.
* Negotiate commission structures: CPS/CPA, tiered, performance-linked and exclusive deals.
* Tracking, Analytics & Reporting
* Track clicks, orders, AOV, new vs. repeat customers, CAC, ROAS, commission payouts and incrementality.
* Ensure accurate attribution (UTM, coupon-level, network-level) and catch fake or duplicate conversions.
* Build weekly/monthly dashboards and partner scorecards; pause low performers and scale winners.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Work with Brand, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, Finance and Tech teams on offers, creatives, tracking setup and payout reconciliation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, performance or e-commerce marketing. Beauty, D2C or FMCG background preferred.
* Hands-on experience with affiliate networks/platforms (Impact, Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission) and cashback/coupon portals.
* Strong understanding of coupon-led and offer-led growth (CPS/CPA, margin math, abuse control).
* Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of GA4 and Shopify analytics.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with super-app/fintech offer platforms (PhonePe, Paytm, GPay, Zomato) or bank/credit-card reward partnerships.
* Understanding of marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Nykaa).

Success Metrics (first 6–12 months)
  
  

* Share of revenue and new-customer count from the affiliate/partnership channel.
* Blended CAC and ROAS within target.
* Number of active partners and top-partner concentration.
* Minimal coupon leakage and invalid payouts.

title: Sr. Vibration Analyst / Customer Success Lead
description:
**Role Description**

 

MachineAstro provides AI- and IoT-enabled machine health and predictive maintenance solutions that help industrial customers detect machine abnormalities early, reduce unplanned downtime and improve asset reliability.
 

The Sr. Vibration Analyst / Customer Success Lead combines strong vibration-analysis expertise with presales, Proof of Concept (POC), customer engagement and account expansion responsibilities. The role works across the complete customer journey, from Site assessment, POC, demo and diagnosis through customer value, billing follow-up, expansion and reference. The incumbent will act as the technical bridge between customers and the Sales, Customer Success, Reliability and Product/AI teams.
 

**Job Profile**

 

* **Vibration Analysis and Diagnostics:**
  Analyse vibration, temperature and machine-health data to identify developing faults. Diagnose issues such as bearing defects, unbalance, misalignment, looseness, gear faults, resonance and other abnormal conditions. Review machine trends and provide actionable maintenance recommendations.
* **Diagnostic Reporting and Asset Selection:**
  Prepare concise diagnostic reports and communicate findings to customer maintenance and reliability teams. Support machine surveys and the selection of critical assets for monitoring.
* **Presales Support:**
  Support the Sales team during technical discussions with prospective customers. Understand customer pain points, machine criticality and maintenance challenges. Conduct technical product demonstrations of MachineAstro's machine-health and predictive-maintenance solutions, prepare technical inputs for proposals, RFQs/RFIs and solution discussions, and support customer presentations, technical meetings and plant visits.
* **Proof of Concept Execution:**
  Define and execute POCs at customer sites. Select suitable machines/assets for POC and establish measurable success criteria. Analyse POC results, demonstrate business and technical value to customers, and convert technical findings into a clear value proposition.

* 𝖠 𝗉𝗋𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝖼𝖺𝗅, 𝗉𝖾𝗋𝗌𝗂𝗌𝗍𝖾𝗇𝗍 𝗆𝗂𝗇𝖽𝗌𝖾𝗍, 𝗌𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝗅𝗈𝗈𝗄𝗌 𝖿𝗈𝗋 𝗌𝗈𝗅𝗎𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇𝗌 𝗂𝗇𝗌𝗍𝖾𝖺𝖽 𝗈𝖿 𝖾𝗑𝖼𝗎𝗌𝖾𝗌.

𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗳𝗶𝘁 𝗶𝗻 𝘄𝗲𝗹𝗹 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲?

* 𝖲𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝗎𝗇𝖽𝖾𝗋𝗌𝗍𝖺𝗇𝖽𝗌 𝗍𝗁𝖺𝗍 𝖾𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗒 𝖼𝗎𝗌𝗍𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗋 𝗂𝗌 𝖽𝗂𝖿𝖿𝖾𝗋𝖾𝗇𝗍, 𝖾𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗒 “𝗇𝗈𝗍 𝗇𝗈𝗐” 𝗁𝖺𝗌 𝖺 𝗋𝖾𝖺𝗌𝗈𝗇, 𝖺𝗇𝖽 𝖾𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗒 𝖿𝗈𝗅𝗅𝗈𝗐-𝗎𝗉 𝗌𝗁𝗈𝗎𝗅𝖽 𝗁𝖺𝗏𝖾 𝖺 𝗉𝗎𝗋𝗉𝗈𝗌𝖾.
* 𝖸𝗈𝗎 𝗌𝗁𝗈𝗎𝗅𝖽 𝖻𝖾 𝖼𝗈𝗆𝖿𝗈𝗋𝗍𝖺𝖻𝗅𝖾 𝗍𝖺𝗅𝗄𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗍𝗈 𝖻𝗎𝗌𝗂𝗇𝖾𝗌𝗌 𝗈𝗐𝗇𝖾𝗋𝗌 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝗆𝖺𝗒 𝖻𝖾 𝖻𝗎𝗌𝗒, 𝗌𝖼𝖾𝗉𝗍𝗂𝖼𝖺𝗅 𝖺𝖻𝗈𝗎𝗍 𝗌𝗈𝖿𝗍𝗐𝖺𝗋𝖾, 𝗌𝗅𝗈𝗐 𝗍𝗈 𝗋𝖾𝗌𝗉𝗈𝗇𝖽 𝗈𝗋 𝗎𝗇𝗌𝗎𝗋𝖾 𝖺𝖻𝗈𝗎𝗍 𝖼𝗁𝖺𝗇𝗀𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗍𝗁𝖾𝗂𝗋 𝖾𝗑𝗂𝗌𝗍𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗐𝖺𝗒 𝗈𝖿 𝗐𝗈𝗋𝗄𝗂𝗇𝗀.
* 𝖸𝗈𝗎 𝖽𝗈𝗇'𝗍 𝗇𝖾𝖾𝖽 𝗍𝗈 𝗄𝗇𝗈𝗐 𝖾𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗒𝗍𝗁𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗈𝗇 𝖽𝖺𝗒 𝗈𝗇𝖾. 𝖡𝗎𝗍 𝗒𝗈𝗎 𝗆𝗎𝗌𝗍 𝖻𝖾 𝖼𝗎𝗋𝗂𝗈𝗎𝗌 𝖾𝗇𝗈𝗎𝗀𝗁 𝗍𝗈 𝗅𝖾𝖺𝗋𝗇, 𝗌𝗁𝖺𝗋𝗉 𝖾𝗇𝗈𝗎𝗀𝗁 𝗍𝗈 𝗎𝗇𝖽𝖾𝗋𝗌𝗍𝖺𝗇𝖽 𝗉𝖾𝗈𝗉𝗅𝖾, 𝖺𝗇𝖽 𝖽𝗂𝗌𝖼𝗂𝗉𝗅𝗂𝗇𝖾𝖽 𝖾𝗇𝗈𝗎𝗀𝗁 𝗍𝗈 𝖿𝗈𝗅𝗅𝗈𝗐 𝗍𝗁𝗋𝗈𝗎𝗀𝗁.

𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗯𝗹𝘆 𝘀𝗸𝗶𝗽 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲?

* 𝖠𝗇𝗒𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝖽𝗂𝗌𝗅𝗂𝗄𝖾𝗌 𝖼𝖺𝗅𝗅𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝖺𝗇𝖽 𝖿𝗈𝗅𝗅𝗈𝗐𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗎𝗉.
* 𝖠𝗇𝗒𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝖾𝗑𝗉𝖾𝖼𝗍𝗌 𝖼𝗎𝗌𝗍𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗋𝗌 𝗍𝗈 𝗅𝖾𝖺𝗋𝗇 𝖾𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗒𝗍𝗁𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗐𝗂𝗍𝗁𝗈𝗎𝗍 𝗀𝗎𝗂𝖽𝖺𝗇𝖼𝖾.
* 𝖠𝗇𝗒𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝗍𝗋𝖾𝖺𝗍𝗌 𝖾𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗒 𝖼𝗎𝗌𝗍𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗋 𝗍𝗁𝖾 𝗌𝖺𝗆𝖾.
* 𝖠𝗇𝗒𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝗂𝗌 𝗎𝗇𝖼𝗈𝗆𝖿𝗈𝗋𝗍𝖺𝖻𝗅𝖾 𝖽𝗂𝗌𝖼𝗎𝗌𝗌𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗉𝗋𝗈𝖽𝗎𝖼𝗍 𝗏𝖺𝗅𝗎𝖾, 𝗉𝗋𝗂𝖼𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗈𝗋 𝗎𝗉𝗀𝗋𝖺𝖽𝖾𝗌.
* 𝖠𝗇𝗒𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝗐𝗁𝗈 𝗎𝗉𝖽𝖺𝗍𝖾𝗌 𝗍𝗁𝖾 𝖢𝖱𝖬 𝗈𝗇𝗅𝗒 𝗐𝗁𝖾𝗇 𝗌𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗈𝗇𝖾 𝖺𝗌𝗄𝗌.

𝖯𝗅𝖾𝖺𝗌𝖾 𝗆𝖺𝗂𝗅 𝗒𝗈𝗎𝗋 𝗋𝖾𝗌𝗎𝗆𝖾 𝖺𝗍
𝗴𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗻𝘀@𝗯𝗶𝗶𝘇𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲.𝗰𝗼𝗺
𝖺𝗅𝗈𝗇𝗀 𝗐𝗂𝗍𝗁:

𝟣. 𝖢𝗎𝗋𝗋𝖾𝗇𝗍 𝗅𝗈𝖼𝖺𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇

𝟤. 𝖢𝗎𝗋𝗋𝖾𝗇𝗍 𝗌𝖺𝗅𝖺𝗋𝗒

𝟥. 𝖤𝗑𝗉𝖾𝖼𝗍𝖾𝖽 𝗌𝖺𝗅𝖺𝗋𝗒

𝟦.
𝗔 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝘀𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

“𝖠 𝖼𝗎𝗌𝗍𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗋 𝗌𝖺𝗒𝗌, ‘
𝗧𝗵𝗲𝗲𝗸 𝗵𝗮𝗶, 𝗯𝗮𝗮𝗱 𝗺𝗲𝗶𝗻 𝗱𝗲𝗸𝗵𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲
’ 𝖾𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗒 𝗍𝗂𝗆𝖾 𝗒𝗈𝗎 𝖼𝖺𝗅𝗅. 𝖶𝗁𝖺𝗍 𝗐𝗈𝗎𝗅𝖽 𝗒𝗈𝗎 𝖽𝗈 𝖽𝗂𝖿𝖿𝖾𝗋𝖾𝗇𝗍𝗅𝗒 𝗂𝗇𝗌𝗍𝖾𝖺𝖽 𝗈𝖿 𝖼𝖺𝗅𝗅𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝖺𝗀𝖺𝗂𝗇 𝖺𝗇𝖽 𝖺𝗌𝗄𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗍𝗁𝖾 𝗌𝖺𝗆𝖾 𝗊𝗎𝖾𝗌𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇?”

𝖶𝖾'𝗋𝖾 𝗂𝗇𝗍𝖾𝗋𝖾𝗌𝗍𝖾𝖽 𝗂𝗇 𝗁𝗈𝗐 𝗒𝗈𝗎 𝗍𝗁𝗂𝗇𝗄, 𝗇𝗈𝗍 𝗃𝗎𝗌𝗍 𝗁𝗈𝗐 𝗐𝖾𝗅𝗅 𝗒𝗈𝗎 𝗐𝗋𝗂𝗍𝖾 𝖺 𝗋𝖾𝗌𝗎𝗆𝖾.

𝗝𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝗕𝗶𝗶𝘇𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲
𝖺𝗇𝖽 𝗁𝖾𝗅𝗉 𝗈𝗎𝗋 𝖼𝗎𝗌𝗍𝗈𝗆𝖾𝗋𝗌 𝗀𝖾𝗍 𝗆𝗈𝗋𝖾 𝗈𝗎𝗍 𝗈𝖿 𝗍𝗁𝖾𝗂𝗋 𝖻𝗎𝗌𝗂𝗇𝖾𝗌𝗌 𝗐𝗁𝗂𝗅𝖾 𝗀𝗋𝗈𝗐𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝗐𝗂𝗍𝗁 𝗎𝗌.

title: Sr. Client Servicing Manager
description:
**Location:**

Experience: 5+ years

Immediate

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive
**Sr. Client**
**Servicing**
**Manager**
with a minimum of
**5 years of experience in an advertising, branding, or digital marketing agency**
. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of client servicing, account management, campaign execution, and strategic client relationships.

Prior experience working with
**healthcare, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, diagnostic centres, wellness brands, or other healthcare-related clients**
will be highly preferred.

The candidate will be responsible for managing key client accounts, translating business objectives into effective marketing strategies, coordinating with internal creative and digital teams, and ensuring seamless campaign execution and client satisfaction.

* Proactively identify opportunities for account growth, upselling, and long-term business partnerships.

* Mentor and guide Client Servicing Executives while ensuring smooth coordination across teams.

title: Customer Success Executive / Specialist (Saleshandy)
description:
**About Saleshandy**
Saleshandy helps sales teams, agencies and founders run cold email outreach that actually lands in the inbox. More than 4,000 customers use us every day to find leads, send sequences and book meetings.
  
  
**About The Role**
Support and success are one team at Saleshandy now. The same person answers a customer on chat, onboards them, and owns the account after that. You'll handle live chat and email, and you'll also look after your own set of accounts. That means onboarding new customers quickly, spotting who might churn before they leave, and finding the ones who could grow with us.
  
  
We're hiring 3 people for this team. You'll report to the Customer Success Team Lead and have a 1:1 with them every week.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Support on chat and email
  
  

* Keep your first response time (FRT) under 15 minutes and reply within 5 to 10 minutes after that
* Keep CSAT at 100%. When a customer leaves a bad rating, review the case and work out what went wrong
* Own escalations and close them within the promised time
* Troubleshoot deliverability issues: why emails land in spam, domain and inbox setup, warm-up
* Handle refund requests. Understand the real problem first and try to fix it before processing the refund
* Pass bugs and product gaps to the Product team with clear examples

Owning your accounts
  
  

* Onboard every new account within 24 to 48 hours, whether it came from Sales or signed up on its own
* Run a 30-60-90 day plan for each new account so they reach value early
* Hold regular check-ins with your accounts and catch churn signals early
* Every week, share your high-risk accounts with the reason each one is at risk, and your high-potential accounts with why each one could grow
* Follow up on voluntary churn, paused accounts, failed payments and overdue renewals. Find out why they left and try to bring them back
* When a high-potential account churns, do an RCA so the same thing doesn't happen again

You'll fit well if you
  
  

* Have 1 to 3 years in customer support, customer success or account management, ideally at a SaaS company. We'll consider freshers who show real ownership
* Write clearly and fast. Most of this job happens over chat and email
* Follow up without being chased and document what you do
* Want to understand why a customer is unhappy before you reply
* Know cold email, outbound tools or email deliverability (a big plus)
* Have used Intercom or a similar support tool
* Are flexible to work day or night shifts. We support customers round the clock across the Americas, EMEA and APAC

What we offer
  
  

* A learning budget for courses, books and events
* Health insurance allowance
* Annual team retreat
* Room to grow into Senior CS, Team Lead or Customer Success Ops

title: General Manager/Sr Manager - Customer Success
description:
Job Title: General Manager / Sr Manager – Customer Success

Location: Ahmedabad | Travel across India

**WHO WE ARE MachineAstro (formerly CIMCON Digital)**

Every manufacturing plant runs on thousands of machines that, until recently, could not tell anyone how they were feeling. MachineAstro changes that.

We are a fast-growing Industrial IoT platform and solutions company that puts sensors, data and AI to work on the plant floor, enabling smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 for some of the most demanding industries in the world. Our solutions span predictive maintenance, energy analytics, digital twins and video analytics, deployed across Cement, Automotive, Chemical, FMCG, Steel, Metals and Pharma. Today,

MachineAstro is trusted by 350+ manufacturing plants across the globe. We have installed 25,000+ IoT devices on 6,000+ assets and helped our customers avoid 8,000+ hours of unplanned downtime. Those are not pilot numbers. They are production numbers, earned one plant at a time.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are entering our next phase of growth and need enterprising, self-motivated people who want to own outcomes. People who are comfortable walking into a steel plant or a pharma line, understanding what keeps the plant head awake at night, and translating that into a solution the customer will pay for and keep. People who treat a customer's downtime as their own problem.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Own key accounts: build and run strategic account plans for assigned manufacturing customers, and be the senior point of contact from plant reliability engineers to business heads.
* Prove value: turn condition-monitoring and diagnostics data into business cases customer leadership will fund - downtime avoided, failures prevented, maintenance cost reduced.
* Grow the account: hunt for opportunities inside existing customers — more assets, more plants and adjacent MachineAstro solutions — through consultative, value-based cross-sell and upsell.
* Be the technical authority: review vibration and condition-monitoring findings with plant teams, validate diagnoses on site, and make sure recommendations are acted on.
* Run executive engagement: lead periodic business reviews with plant and corporate leadership, presenting outcomes, risks and the expansion roadmap.
* Lead cross-functionally: coordinate deployment, analytics, product and sales teams to resolve escalations and close the loop on customer issues.
* Be on the plant floor: travel to customer plants and sites across India.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* BE / B.Tech: Mechanical Engineering preferred.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in industry, reliability, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, industrial automation, consultative selling or related fields.
* CAT-II / CAT-III Vibration Certification is strongly preferred.
* MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience with manufacturing / process industries is highly desirable.
* Strong strategic key account management, account expansion, cross-sell and upsell skills.
* Proven opportunity hunting, consultative selling, value selling and business case development abilities.
* Sound understanding of vibration and condition monitoring.
* Comfortable engaging with plant engineers as well as senior business leaders, combining technical credibility with strong commercial ownership.
* Strong customer and executive stakeholder management, problem-solving and cross-functional leadership. - Strong communication, presentation and plant-level engagement skills.
* Flexibility to travel to customer plants and sites across India.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Health insurance coverage
* Dynamic work environment
* Opportunity to learn with growth mindset team

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your resume to naina@machineastro.com with the subject line "GM / Sr Manager – Customer Success".

title: Assistant General Manager - CRM
description:
**Job Description:**

**Department:**
Ortho

**Job Title:**
Assistant General Manager - CRM

**Job Location:**
Corporate Office, Ahmedabad

**Experience Required:**
15 to 20 Years

**Role Objective:**

* To lead and govern the international distribution business and customer relationship management function for the
  **Ortho vertical.**
  The role is accountable for
  **export sales invoicing**
  ,
  **customer acquisition and upgrades**
  ,
  **premium-product revenue mix**
  ,
  **DSO and collections, forecasting, order-to-cash governance, customer service, distributor management, process compliance, digital transformation**
  through SAP and Salesforce, and the development of a robust CRM organization. The role must provide clear commercial direction, review performance at defined intervals, remove execution bottlenecks and ensure that business commitments are delivered through disciplined cross-functional coordination.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

**International Business Strategy and Revenue Delivery**

* Translate the approved annual international distribution strategy into market-wise, quarter-wise and customer-wise execution plans.
* Own the achievement of the approved export distribution sales invoicing target and review progress against quarterly milestones.
* Drive year-on-year growth through existing-customer expansion, new customer acquisition, customer upgrades and improved premium-product penetration.
* Review the performance of assigned regions, distribution partners, direct offices and customer segments, and implement corrective actions for target gaps.
* Lead preparation for the annual business plan and budget process and ensure that the operating plan is supported by realistic forecasts, customer actions and collection plans.

**Business Development and Customer Growth**

* Engage existing and potential international customers for business development and relationship expansion.
* Establish customer-segmentation priorities and ensure structured engagement with A and B customers, along with periodic follow-up for C and D customers.
* Drive business from new and upgraded customers in line with the approved annual and quarterly contribution targets.
* Review regional opportunities, market constraints, forecast-versus-actual gaps and customer-specific actions with regional stakeholders.

**CRM and Customer-Service Governance**

* Ensure a high and consistent level of service to existing and potential customers throughout the enquiry-to-order, order-to-shipment and post-shipment lifecycle.
* Lead CRM governance across assigned markets, including customer master data, follow-up trackers, customer health reports, customer feedback, open-point closure and service escalations.
* Ensure timely customer communication on order status, documentation, payments, shipment schedules, complaints, returns and regulatory requirements.
* Review customer follow-up presentations, customer-focused inputs, collected 4Q feedback and customer action plans before management reviews.
* Ensure that the CRM team maintains complete, accurate and current records in Salesforce, SAP and approved trackers.

**Sales Forecasting, Invoice Planning and Performance Reviews**

* Govern the 12-week rolling forecast process and ensure that forecast inputs are collected, validated, consolidated and reviewed at the prescribed frequency.
* Review the monthly invoice plan, expected sales and collection position, order pipeline, dispatch readiness and forecast-versus-actual challenges.
* Review sales, order, invoice and collection dashboards and ensure that data is available for global sales and collection performance meetings.
* Ensure periodic review of order-to-shipment reports, customer health reports, pending sales orders and key operational trackers.

**Order-to-Cash, DSO and Collection Control**

* Own DSO performance for the assigned international distribution business and drive progressive achievement of the approved quarterly DSO milestones.
* Review customer ledgers, overdue and due receivables, collection plans, credit risks and shipment holds with the CRM team.
* Ensure that monthly collection plans are prepared, communicated and actively followed up with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that proforma invoices, sales contracts and orders are processed within the approved turnaround time, subject to receipt of advance payment where applicable.
* Ensure that orders are correctly created, verified, approved and released in SAP and that OBD, invoicing and shipment activities are completed within defined service levels.
* Escalate material payment, credit, documentation or shipment risks early and ensure closure through cross-functional coordination.

**Distributor Agreements and Commercial Documentation**

* Oversee preparation, validation, issuance and execution of distributor agreements for assigned markets.
* Ensure that agreement data is correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP and Salesforce.
* Oversee preparation and customer acceptance of sales contracts, pro forma invoices and related commercial documents for each order.
* Drive implementation and adoption of the Agreement Module in Salesforce in accordance with the approved project plan and go-live milestone.
* Ensure document completeness, version control, approval compliance and accessibility for audit and operational use.

**Logistics, Shipment and Inventory Coordination**

* Review order and logistics efficiency, pending dispatches, shipment risks and order-to-shipment performance with CRM and logistics stakeholders.
* Support the transition and review of FOB-to-CIF processes and ensure that nominated-agent details are made available for FOB shipments where required.
* Review non-moving stock and ensure that market, customer and shipment actions are defined and tracked to reduce inventory risk.
* Ensure timely resolution of documentation, payment, regulatory and logistics issues that may delay shipment.
* Govern implementation of the Salesforce Freight Portal and ensure process adoption after go-live.

**Regulatory, Quality, PMS and Returns Coordination**

* Ensure that product registration information and certificates received from customers or regional teams are shared with the Regulatory function in a timely manner.
* Ensure follow-up on product registration trackers with the Regulatory team for assigned markets.
* Ensure collection and tracking of customer-wise and product-wise post-market-surveillance feedback in line with defined requirements.
* Ensure that customer complaints are supported by complete complaint forms and routed through the approved quality-management process, including Track Wise/DMS activities.
* Ensure that goods-return details are correctly processed in SAP after confirmation from the relevant stores or operations team.
* Support applicable MDR and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of assigned observations.

**Systems, Digital Transformation and Process Improvement**

* Drive SAP-Salesforce automation, Salesforce master-data quality, process controls and management dashboards, including Power BI or other approved tools.
* Lead the Agreement Module and Freight Portal projects in Salesforce from project initiation through go-live and stabilization.
* Support development and adoption of online PMS feedback tools and other approved CRM/process solutions.
* Review process performance, identify control gaps, standardize workflows and sponsor continuous-improvement initiatives through the Menlo Park/Kaizen mechanism.

**Management Reporting, Meetings and Compliance**

* Prepare and present accurate information for management reviews, global sales and collection performance meetings, customer-focused meetings and business-plan discussions.
* Ensure that dashboards, trackers and review packs clearly show target achievement, DSO, collections, forecasts, customer actions, premium-product mix, new/upgrade business and project status.

**Functional Skills Required:**

* International distribution sales strategy and business development
* CRM governance, customer lifecycle management and service escalation
* Sales forecasting, gap analysis, pipeline and performance dashboards
* DSO, receivables, collection planning and credit-risk management
* Order-to-cash process, SAP order release, OBD, invoicing and shipment coordination
* Distributor agreements, sales contracts and proforma-invoice governance
* SAP and Salesforce implementation, automation and master-data control
* Management reporting, Power BI/analytics and executive presentations
* Regulatory registration, PMS feedback, complaint and returns coordination
* Process improvement, SOP governance, audits, budgeting and project management
* Team structure design, performance management, coaching and capability building

**Behavioural Skills Required:**

* Customer orientation and service ownership
* Commercial drive, aggressiveness and will to win
* Innovation, adaptability and change leadership
* Entrepreneurial thinking and opportunity orientation
* Passion, commitment and personal accountability
* Analytical thinking and evidence-based decision-making
* Clear communication, influencing and cross-cultural stakeholder management
* Respectful people leadership, coaching, collaboration, high process discipline, integrity, effective prioritization and timely action closure

**Team Size to be Handled:**

* Role involves managing a team of 2 members.

**Specific Professional Competencies:**

* Business Acumen, Customer Focus, Drive for results, Problem-solving, Peer relationship, Negotiation skills, Functional/ technical skills, Presentation skills, Adherence to Ethics and Values, Integrity.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
SHAH PANCHAL & ASSOCIATES is a consulting firm that supports businesses across accounts, tax, finance, legal, and international business affairs. The firm has a strong focus on helping clients navigate complex regulatory and compliance requirements while optimizing their financial and operational performance. It is recognized for its specialized expertise in real estate matters and cross-border transactions, providing tailored advisory services for domestic and international clients. Team members work closely with diverse businesses, offering strategic guidance and practical solutions to support growth and risk management.

**Role Description**
The Senior Account Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for overseeing key client accounts, managing day-to-day communication, and ensuring timely delivery of services in accounts, tax, finance, legal, and international business domains. The Senior Account Manager will review financial statements, coordinate tax filings, monitor compliance deadlines, and support real estate and cross-border transaction advisory work. The role includes supervising junior team members, allocating workloads, and maintaining high-quality documentation and reporting standards. The Senior Account Manager will also identify opportunities to expand client relationships, prepare proposals, and collaborate with internal specialists to address complex client requirements.

* Strong expertise in accounting, taxation, and financial reporting, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex portfolios.
* Experience in legal and regulatory compliance relevant to business operations, including documentation review and coordination with legal advisors.

* Exposure to real estate matters, such as transaction structuring, due diligence support, and financial evaluation of property-related deals.

* Proven capability to lead a team, delegate tasks, mentor junior staff, and maintain high standards of accuracy and integrity.
* Relevant professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA in Finance, or an equivalent degree; prior experience in consulting or professional services is preferred.

title: Account Manager - Lab Chemicals
description:

 Education: Graduate / Postgraduate in Science, MBA is an added advantage.

 None

title: Director - Aftermarket

**Core Responsibilities**

**Strategy \& Growth Roadmap**

* P\&L ownership across sales and service lines


**Analytics \& Planning**
* Data\-driven performance management with strong revenue forecasting capability
* Strategic roadmap development and governance planning
* Target setting, pipeline tracking and proficiency in MIS / BI tools


**Leadership**
* Cross\-functional leadership – ability to align Sales, Spares, Service and Supply Chain
* Executive and board\-level communication
* Team building across central and distributed regional teams


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of total experience, with at least 5–7 years in aftermarket, service or B2B industrial sales leadership roles
* Demonstrated P\&L ownership in capital goods, industrial equipment or allied sectors (e.g., compressors, machine tools, auto components, material handling)

* Experience managing large, geographically distributed field teams (service engineers, sales managers)
* Exposure to channel/dealer networks and distributor management is a strong plus

 \&

**Company Description** 
 GCL Dreams is part of GCL, one of India’s leading diversified financial services groups, promoted by a family with decades of experience in financial markets. As a member of major exchanges such as NSE, BSE, MCX, and NCDEX, GCL offers robust online and offline platforms for investing, hedging, and trading. The organization focuses on delivering expert financial services tailored to clients’ present and future needs. GCL has grown from an entrepreneurial start\-up to a market leader by adapting to changing market conditions while maintaining a strong focus on its core financial services domain.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for building, managing, and strengthening relationships with existing and prospective clients across GCL Dreams’ financial products and services. Day\-to\-day activities include understanding client goals, recommending suitable investment and trading solutions, addressing queries, and ensuring timely resolution of service issues. The Relationship Manager will regularly follow up with clients, assist with account opening and documentation, and coordinate with internal teams to deliver a seamless client experience. The role also involves identifying new business opportunities, meeting defined sales and retention targets, and maintaining accurate records of client interactions and portfolios.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management skills, including ability to build trust, understand client needs, and provide tailored financial solutions.
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills to explain financial products clearly and handle client queries professionally.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of capital markets, trading, and investment products; prior experience in financial services or brokerage is an advantage.
* Proficiency in using CRM tools, MS Office, and online trading or investment platforms.
* Ability to work towards sales and retention targets, with good negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., NISM) are beneficial.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and a customer\-centric mindset.
* Comfort working in an on\-site environment in Ahmedabad and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and result\-driven Key Account Manager to manage and expand our solar product sales in Ahmedabad. The candidate will be responsible for handling key accounts and driving revenue through the sale of complete solar solutions, including solar panels, inverters, wires, and other related components. The role involves working with both B2B and B2C customers, ensuring strong client relationships and consistent business growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Drive sales of solar kits and complete solar solutions across B2B and B2C segments
* Manage and maintain relationships with key clients, dealers, and distributors
* Identify new business opportunities and generate leads
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to overall business growth
* Provide customers with appropriate product recommendations based on their requirements
* Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, installation, and after\-sales support
* Keep updated with market trends, competitor activities, and product knowledge


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 1–2 years of experience in the solar industry (mandatory)
* Prior experience in sales of solar kits or related products is required
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred)


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage both corporate (B2B) and retail (B2C) customers
* Target\-oriented with a proactive approach
* Good problem\-solving and customer relationship management skills


**Other Requirements**
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently


 Skills: b2c,strong communication,b2b

title: Live Chat Team Leader/Manager – for Billing & Technical Queries - UK Telcoms Provider Location: Onsite, Pune India (UK Hours)
description:
My Client, a leading Telecoms provider to 40,000 UK small businesses has a rare opportunity for an experienced individual to
 **build and lead their Live Chat Support team in Pune, India.** 




  





 Reporting to the Head of Operations (Ex Amazon leader) who is based in their Cape Town office, the Team Leader will be responsible for starting up and growing a new Live Chat team in India to handle tech support and some billing customer queries. The individual must be able to hire, manage and motivate a high performance chat team providing exceptional support, transitioning smoothly from their current Cape Town Live Chat operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Master the company Product Knowledge and technical troubleshooting.** 




  




* Onboard, coach, lead and motivate a team of Chat Support Agents providing billing and tech support.
* Manage day\-to\-day performance, attendance, quality and customer satisfaction during UK business hours 9am to 6pm BST.
* Provide guidance and escalation support for complex billing and technical issues.
* Ensure customer queries are handled efficiently and in line with company processes and SLAs.
* Conduct regular 1\-to\-1's, performance reviews and coaching sessions.
* Identify training and development needs and support Agent progression and growth.
* Work closely with technical, billing and other internal teams to resolve customer issues.
* Monitor team KPIs and implement improvements where required.
* Promote a positive, accountable and customer\-focused team culture.Can we add something relating to the hours or shifts etc?



  





**Key Requirements:** 




  




* Must have proven experience leading an International Chat Support team.
* 2–5 years’ experience managing in a fast\-paced, Tech Support Customer Service environment.
* Proven experience leading, coaching and developing a team of excellent agents.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong motivational, coaching and performance management skills.
* Experience supporting customers with billing and/or technical queries.
* Comfortable working with chat\-based support and cutting edge, AI\-based solutions like FIN.ai.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical and decision\-making abilities.
* Customer\-focused, meticulous and results oriented.
* Experience within VoIP, Telecoms or Software would be helpful.



  





*Due to high application volumes, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted \- but we genuinely review, appreciate and value every application and wish you the very best in your search. Please follow us for future roles.*
